svg.title: KMS Spring Boot support map
svg.desc: AWS KMS auto-configuration creates a coroutine operations API, optional data-key cache, TextEncryptor adapter, and field encryption codec.
svg.text: KMS support exposes coroutine operations first, then optional adapters for synchronous text and field-level use cases.
Method context overrides defaults and must match decrypt.
Use stable identifiers such as service, tenant, or purpose; never store secrets in context.
KmsOperations remains the coroutine-first service API.
TextEncryptor blocks by contract; field codec is explicit and String-only.
KMS auto-configuration registers client, operations, data-key cache, TextEncryptor, and explicit field encryption helpers.
